statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness suggestive of paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
There is a need for continuous rhythm correlation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring study, CPT 93229, was ordered.
The service was ordered to capture arrhythmic events during daily activities.
The diagnosis codes are I49.9 and I47.1.
The claim was denied under reason code CO-197.
